faqs.question: What is the Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) for wholesale tier pricing?
faqs.answer: Our catalog allows small trial packs (starting at 5-10 units) up to massive master production lots. Volume discounts automatically apply: 15% off for 10-49 packs, and 30% off for 50+ packs.

faqs.question: Are your pewter components and charms certified lead-free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every pewter finding is 100% certified lead-free (<90 ppm) and cadmium-free, fully compliant with US CPSIA, California Prop 65, and European REACH regulations.

faqs.question: How quickly do international orders ship?
faqs.answer: Standard catalog orders are dispatched from our central warehouse within 24 to 48 hours via DHL Express Worldwide or FedEx International Priority, arriving in 3-5 business days globally.

faqs.question: Can I submit a custom Request for Quote (RFQ) for custom casting or bespoke plating?
faqs.answer: Yes! Use our multi-product RFQ builder to specify custom casting shapes, finish plating (18K Gold, Rhodium, Antique Bronze), and target pricing. Our production desk reviews and returns firm quotes within 24 hours.
